subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After both documentation redirects are restored and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103604 lands, should the exact head be authorized to remove the qa-matrix workspace package and lockfile importer?
rationale: Repository automation intentionally blocks dependency graph changes until an administrator or security owner approves the reviewed head, and automation cannot make that authorization or stack-order decision.

options.title: Authorize the completed cleanup
options.body: Restore both redirects, land the dependent stack first, then approve the exact reviewed head for package and importer removal.

options.title: Retain the compatibility package
options.body: Pause this final cleanup and keep qa-matrix until maintainers choose a later removal window or a different ownership boundary.

recommendation.title: Authorize the completed cleanup
recommendation.body: Restore both redirects, land the dependent stack first, then approve the exact reviewed head for package and importer removal.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent packaging and QA-boundary work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the package-removal authorization and stack coordination.
